title: storytold/wordcraft
why_read: An ambitious clean-room Rust reimplementation of Microsoft Word is a serious systems engineering undertaking worth a look for anyone interested in document format compatibility.
analysis: This project claims to reimplement Microsoft Word's functionality from scratch in Rust, which would require reverse-engineering or reimplementing the complex .docx format, layout engine, and rich text editing behavior. Building a compatible word processor is notoriously hard due to decades of legacy formatting quirks and OOXML complexity, so a serious attempt is technically interesting regardless of how complete it is. The choice of Rust suggests a focus on memory safety and performance for a traditionally C++-dominated application category. Worth checking the actual feature completeness before taking the claim at face value.
